p: Sec. 46a-1. Permanent Commission on the Status of Women. Membership. Terms. Vacancies. Executive director. Personnel. Section 46a-1 is repealed, effective July 1, 2016.
Sec. 46a-2. Appointment and terms of members. Expenses. Section 46a-2 is repealed, effective October 5, 2009.
Sec. 46a-3. Review of statutes. Report of findings and recommendations. Section 46a-3 is repealed, effective October 5, 2009.
Sec. 46a-4. Duties generally. Annual report. Staff. Recommendations and advocacy. Section 46a-4 is repealed, effective July 1, 2016.
Sec. 46a-4a. Collection of information on job-sharing. Distribution. Section 46a-4a is repealed, effective October 1, 2002.

Sec. 46a-4b. Training program on trafficking in persons. The Commission on Women, Children, Seniors, Equity and Opportunity, in conjunction with the Police Officer Standards and Training Council, shall develop a training program on trafficking in persons and make such training program available, upon request, to the Division of State Police within the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection, the office of the Chief State's Attorney, local police departments and community organizations.

History: P.A. 06-43 effective July 1, 2006; pursuant to P.A. 11-51, “Department of Public Safety” was changed editorially by the Revisors to “Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection”, effective July 1, 2011; May Sp. Sess. P.A. 16-3 replaced “Permanent Commission on the Status of Women” with “Commission on Women, Children and Seniors”, effective July 1, 2016; P.A. 19-117 replaced “Commission on Women, Children and Seniors” with “Commission on Women, Children, Seniors, Equity and Opportunity”, effective July 1, 2019.
Sec. 46a-5. Authority generally. Section 46a-5 is repealed, effective July 1, 2016.
Sec. 46a-6. Assistance from state agencies. Acceptance of funds. Section 46a-6 is repealed, effective October 5, 2009.
